scope: Interactive source qualification: audio/network plus UFS, display/GPU, candidate touch, NFC, PMIC haptics/keys; still NOT complete device coverage or flashable.

reference.kernel_dts: R16 Annibale audio candidate with DMIC GPIO 183/182; see devicetrees docs/annibale-r16-validation.json

phy_msm_m31_eusb2.reason: Annibale DT annibale-mtp.dtsi eusb2_phy0 usb-repeater phandle targets pmih010x_eusb2_repeater; driver devm_usb_get_repeater_by_phandle consumes this runtime dependency.

machine_dlkm.reason: Reviewed source audio DT: explicit smartpa pair, asoc-codec stub/haptics, LPI DMIC pinctrl and LPASS macro providers; ADSP loader retained for DSP startup. SIA tuning is a family userspace service. These runtime links are not all represented by ELF imports.

sia91xx_dlkm.reason: Both candidates place the amplifier pair under qupv3_hub_i2c0 (qcom,i2c-geni) and consume SUN TLMM reset/switch pins. Reviewed bus/pinctrl suppliers, not a complete DT supplier traversal.

msm_drm.reason: Annibale display + Sun MDSS: DISPCC/GCC clocks, RPMH oscillator/rails, SUN interconnect and panel reset TLMM; fixed panel VDDD regulator is built in. Xiaomi display feature ABI remains outside this provider selection.

msm_kgsl.reason: graphics/gpu/sun-gpu.dtsi: GPUCC GDSCs and GMU clocks, GCC memory clocks, RPMH XO, GEMNOC/MC interconnect. Select the matching SUN GPU DT overlay separately.

goodix_core.reason: Annibale Goodix node on qupv3_se2_spi consumes GENI/GPI, SUN reset/IRQ pins, L12B and fixed AVDD rails and display panel notifications. This remains the Warsaw-family candidate, not published P11 source.

nxp_nci.reason: Annibale qcom,sn-nci under qupv3_se0_i2c uses GENI I2C and NFC TLMM pinctrl; HAL/firmware unverified.

qcom_hv_haptics.reason: Annibale pmih010x_haptics uses the PMIC SPMI parent and pmk8550_sdam_46 NVMEM provider; retain existing actuator settings.

pm8941_pwrkey.reason: PMIC PON key node requires SPMI parent/regmap. GPIO volume-up uses built-in gpio_keys and the PMIC GPIO provider.

ufs_qcom.reason: Sun UFS node phys=ufsphy_mem: SUN QMP PHY, GCC/RPMH/TCSR reference clocks, SUN interconnect and UFS rails must exist before first-stage DLKM mounts.

tmecom_intf.reason: sun.dtsi qcom,tmecom-qmp-client consumes qmp_tme mailbox; source tmecom requests the channel at probe.

msm_qmp.reason: sun.dtsi qmp_tme uses IPCC_CLIENT_TME through ipcc_mproc; select the real mailbox/IRQ provider before the TME client.
